visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, glasses, and a yellow t-shirt stands in a domestic setting, speaking directly to the camera with high energy. He gestures with his hands, occasionally touching his nose and face. The background is a brightly lit indoor area with a white slatted door and wooden accents. (2) The scene transitions to a domestic patio at night where abalones are seen cooking on a charcoal grill. A small girl in a grey shirt is shown eating and singing. The man and girl are then seen together near wooden paneling, interacting playfully. (3) The man and girl are outside on a concrete driveway at night. A mouse is spotted running across the ground near a metal gate. The man follows the mouse with the camera as it disappears into a hole. (4) The final segment shows the girl running along a paved path in a large open park with green grass under a cloudy sky. The man, now wearing a grey t-shirt and a black sun hat, follows her while looking exhausted and talking to the camera.
